title: Kentucky EEO-1 employer information report instructions — 2010/2011 historical reference
authority: Kentucky Finance and Administration Cabinet, Office of Equal Employment Opportunity/Contract Compliance
key_historical_rules: The instructions identify KRS 45.560-KRS 45.640 as the legal authority for filing.
Incomplete, blank, unsigned, mathematically inconsistent or substitute reports are described as not processable.
Workforce data are reported by one job category per employee and one race/ethnicity category per employee.
The instructions require row/column totals and a matching grand total.
The job-category guide explicitly places truck, bus and taxi drivers under Operatives.
Vehicle/equipment cleaners and laborers are examples under Laborers and Helpers; janitors/cleaners/porters are examples under Service Workers.
The source recommends offering employees voluntary self-identification and keeping race/ethnicity records separate from basic personnel records.
link_to_rtec_history: The 2018 RTEC category-change notice says drivers were moved from Service Workers to Operatives, garage staff from Operatives to Laborers/Helpers, and custodian from Operatives to Service Workers to align with the EEO-1 Job Classification Guide 2010.
This reference therefore explains the classification logic behind the major longitudinal AAP remapping.
currentness_boundary: These are 2010/2011 reporting instructions and must not be used as the current filing procedure without checking the present Kentucky/EEOC reporting requirements.
The source's demographic-data collection guidance is historical reference only; current HR privacy/data-collection practice must follow current approved policy and law.
